senses.gloss: koḍa, MIndic for kroḍa, breast: koḍa-sakkino SP 〔95.3〕 (vs), so both edd. and most mss. (v.l. kroḍa˚). See also s.v. kola (2).

Koḍya, Kroḍya, Krauḍya, m. pl. (= Pali and BHS Koliya), n. of a people, neighbors of the Śākyas: LV 〔225.6〕, Koḍyān (Calc.; Lefm. Kro˚, semi-Sktized, no v.l.) [] atikramya; in MPS 〔51.13〕 fully Sktized as Krauḍya, living at Rāmagrāmaka, q.v.
